svg.title: Artha ledger and shared-money architecture
svg.desc: Ledger architecture separating spending, transfers, card payments, shared allocations and settlements while deriving safe read models.

g.text: One accounting core; different transaction meanings stay distinct.
All money values use integer paise; every command is validated by type
One server-owned path preserves semantic and tenant invariants
The same confirmed facts power every view without changing transaction meaning
Transfers and card payments move money; they do not create spending.
Splits track personal share separately from cash movement.
